name: Christchurch Golf Club
description: A premier Canterbury club ranked in the top 20 in New Zealand, recently upgraded to deliver a quasi-links feel. The course combines strategic bunkering with excellent conditioning, making it one of the finest tests of golf in the South Island.

name: Clearwater Golf Club
description: A premium resort course on a lake near Christchurch airport, designed to international standards. The water features, mature plantings, and mountain backdrop create a stunning setting for a challenging and memorable round.

name: Russley Golf Club
description: A quality Christchurch parkland club conveniently located near the airport. The well-established tree-lined fairways and manicured greens provide an excellent test of golf in a mature, attractive setting.

name: Hagley Golf Club
description: A popular public course in Hagley Park near the Christchurch CBD, offering accessible golf in a beautiful park setting. The flat, walkable layout is ideal for casual rounds, with mature trees framing the fairways.

name: Greendale Golf Club
description: Situated 40 km from Christchurch on the banks of the Selwyn River, this course offers 18 holes of relaxed country golf. Well maintained by a full-time greenkeeper, with irrigated greens, tee blocks, and partial fairway watering ensuring excellent playing conditions.

name: Hawarden Golf Club
description: A well-manicured 9-hole in the Hurunui region of North Canterbury, established in 1924 and set beside the village of Hawarden. The course sits on two levels separated by a stream, with tree-lined fairways and exceptional attention paid to the greens.

name: Kaituna Golf Club
description: A unique 9-hole course on Kaitorete Spit, 48 km south of Christchurch off the main Akaroa highway. The tussock-covered, free-draining terrain means the course stays playable year-round, even when other Canterbury courses are waterlogged in winter.

name: Mackenzie Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole in the Mackenzie Country with views toward the Southern Alps and surrounding high-country farmland. The peaceful setting and uncrowded fairways make it an appealing stop for golfers exploring the region.

name: Maungati Golf Club
description: A character-filled 9-hole course in a valley between the extinct volcano Mt Horrible and the Hunter Hills, north of Waimate. The unique layout and dramatic landscape offer a classic South Canterbury country golfing experience.

name: Mt Nessing Golf Club
description: Established in 1939 near Albury in the Mackenzie Country, this 9-hole course features several memorable holes. The signature first hole, "Aorangi," rewards golfers on clear days with a perfect view of Aoraki/Mount Cook northward over Burkes Pass.

name: Scargill Golf Club
description: Established in 1934 in the Scargill Valley, just one hour north of Christchurch off State Highway 1. This welcoming rural 9-hole is set among rolling North Canterbury hills and open countryside, offering a relaxed yet rewarding experience.

name: Temuka Golf Club
description: Located 1 km east of State Highway 1 on parkland within the Temuka town boundary. The accessible, flat layout makes it an easy and enjoyable course for golfers of all levels visiting South Canterbury.

name: Terrace Downs High Country Resort & Golf Club
description: New Zealand's only high-country golf course, set just one hour from Christchurch near Mt Hutt ski field and Methven. This par 72 championship layout delivers breathtaking views from every hole, with the Southern Alps providing a dramatic alpine backdrop.

name: Waimate Golf Club
description: A beautifully maintained course on the western outskirts of Waimate, 47 km south of Timaru. The signature 18th is a deceptively challenging 410-metre par 4, capping off an enjoyable round through well-kept Canterbury countryside.

name: Weedons Country Club
description: A quality 18-hole par 73 course just 20 minutes south of Christchurch Square, featuring tree-lined fairways and numerous doglegs that challenge the best golfers. The country club atmosphere and well-maintained layout make it a popular choice in the Selwyn district.

name: Avondale Golf Club
description: A testing 18-hole course on the east side of Christchurch, approximately 10 minutes from the city centre towards New Brighton.

name: Bottle Lake Golf Club
description: A welcoming club in the Parklands area of Christchurch, formerly known as Burwood then Windsor. More than 50 years of history.

name: Coringa Golf Club
description: One of Christchurch's premier golfing destinations on McLeans Island Road, offering a picturesque and challenging 18-hole championship course.

name: Harewood Golf Club
description: An 18-hole course in the Harewood area of Christchurch, close to the airport.

name: Rawhiti Golf Club
description: An 18-hole course in New Brighton, Christchurch.

name: Waimairi Beach Golf Club
description: A professional and friendly club in the Parklands area of Christchurch with a strong reputation for welcoming players of all abilities.

name: Waitikiri Golf Club
description: Located in the north-east of Christchurch opposite Bottle Lake Forest, only 15 minutes from the city centre. Recognised as one of the top courses in Canterbury.

name: Gleniti Golf Club
description: An 18-hole course on the eastern outskirts of Timaru with wonderful views from the Southern Alps to the sea. Founded in 1928.

name: Grande Vue Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course in Geraldine, South Canterbury.

name: Highfield Golf Club
description: Timaru's most conveniently located course, in the heart of the city. A 13-hole layout playable as 9 or 18 from different tees.

name: The Cairns Golf Course
description: A 9-hole course near Lake Tekapo in the Mackenzie Country.

name: Tinwald Golf Club
description: An 18-hole par 72 course on the south side of Ashburton. Country hospitality with a friendly atmosphere welcoming visitors.

name: McLeans Island Golf Club
description: Set in the tranquil surroundings of McLeans Island, a short drive from Christchurch city. This small, friendly club welcomes visitors to enjoy a peaceful round in a natural setting away from the urban bustle.

name: Ben Ohau Golf Club
description: A scenic 9-hole course with 16 tees in the heart of the Mackenzie Country near Twizel, offering magnificent views of Aoraki/Mount Cook and the surrounding peaks. The high-country setting and crisp mountain air make every round here truly special.

name: Cheviot Golf Club
description: A rare 12-hole layout established in 1925, set five minutes west of Cheviot township in North Canterbury. The course features views of the Kaikoura Mountains and a tranquil stream weaving through the fairways, offering an ideal length when 18 is too much and 9 too few.

name: Everglades Country Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course established in 1967, located 20 minutes north of central Christchurch. Bordered by the Kaputone stream on two sides, the challenge lies in navigating tree-lined fairways and relatively compact greens.

name: Burnham Golf Club Inc.
description: An 18-hole course nestled in the countryside south of Rolleston, established in 1953. The flat, easy-walking layout features tightly tree-lined fairways that demand accuracy off the tee and precise iron play into the greens.

name: Charteris Bay Golf Club
description: A charming 9-hole on the south side of Lyttelton Harbour, set within the beautiful Orton Bradley Estate. The course offers magnificent views of the harbour, Mt Bradley, and Mt Herbert, combining scenic coastal golf with a peaceful country atmosphere.

name: Akaroa Golf Club
description: Situated at Duvauchelle on Banks Peninsula, just 10 minutes from Akaroa and 90 minutes from Christchurch. Regarded as one of the most scenic courses in Canterbury, the dramatic volcanic harbour landscape provides a breathtaking backdrop to every hole.

name: Amuri Golf Club
description: Established in 1924, this North Canterbury course sits between Rotherham and Waiau among spectacular mountain scenery. Mount Lyford rises to the north while a mountain range frames the western horizon, creating a memorable alpine setting for a round of golf.

name: Culverden Golf Club
description: Established in 1941, this 9-hole course sits on the beautiful Amuri Basin countryside, 37 km south of Hanmer Springs. Views stretch from the inland and seaward Kaikoura Ranges to the Southern Alps, while a winding creek adds challenge to the layout.

name: Ellesmere Golf Club
description: An 18-hole par 72 course located 3 km south of Leeston township. An extensive irrigation system keeps the fairways and greens in excellent condition for year-round golf across the Canterbury Plains.

name: Hanmer Springs Golf Club
description: Set in the charming alpine village of Hanmer Springs, 135 km northwest of Christchurch. The mountain scenery and crisp high-country air create a delightful setting, making this a perfect round to complement a visit to the famous thermal pools.

name: Hororata Golf Club
description: Among the most picturesque clubs in Canterbury, set on two levels of river flats with streams winding through the course. Located in the small rural town of Glentunnel, just 35 minutes west of Christchurch, the natural water features and lush setting create a beautiful golfing environment.

name: Mayfield Golf Club
description: One of the best 9-hole country courses in the Ashburton area, situated on the north bank of the Hinds River. Good drainage keeps the course playable in winter, while fairway irrigation ensures lush conditions through summer.

name: Pegasus Golf Club
description: Located just north of Christchurch in the heart of Pegasus town, this course is renowned as one of the best in New Zealand. Set against a diverse landscape of mountains, water features, and the natural wetlands of Pegasus Bay, it delivers a first-class golfing experience.

name: Tai Tapu Golf Club
description: Widely considered the best 9-hole course in Canterbury, Tai Tapu is a pleasant, compact layout just 16 km from Christchurch along the Akaroa Highway. The country setting and quality conditions make it a favourite for golfers seeking a quick but satisfying round.

name: Waimakariri Gorge Golf Club
description: Formed in 1961 on crown land near the Waimakariri Gorge bridge, at the foothills of the magnificent Southern Alps. The course is only 30 minutes from Christchurch International Airport, offering a scenic escape with mountain views in every direction.

name: Selwyn Golf Club
description: A growing club in the fast-expanding Selwyn district southwest of Christchurch. The course caters well to the area's increasing population, providing an accessible and enjoyable golfing option on the Canterbury Plains.

name: Timaru Golf Club
description: The main South Canterbury club in Timaru, providing the region's premier golfing experience. Well-established fairways and quality greens make it the first choice for competitive and social golf in the area.

name: Templeton Golf Club
description: An affordable parkland course west of Christchurch, offering a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere for golfers of all skill levels. The flat, easy-walking layout makes it a good choice for casual rounds.

name: Rangiora Golf Club
description: A popular North Canterbury club in the thriving town of Rangiora, just 30 minutes from Christchurch. The mature parkland setting and well-conditioned course make it a favourite among local and visiting golfers.

name: Ashburton Golf Club
description: The main Mid-Canterbury club in Ashburton, serving as the hub for golf in the district. The well-maintained parkland layout offers an enjoyable round on the fertile Canterbury Plains, with views toward the Southern Alps.

name: Kaikoura Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland course in Kaikoura where dramatic mountain views meet the Pacific Ocean. The unique coastal mountain setting, with the snow-capped Seaward Kaikoura Range as a backdrop, makes this one of New Zealand's most photogenic golfing locations.

name: Aorangi Golf Club
description: A second Timaru course offering affordable golf in South Canterbury. The friendly atmosphere and accessible layout make it a welcoming option for golfers of all abilities.

name: Lincoln Golf Club
description: A pleasant course in the university town of Lincoln, south of Christchurch. The rural Canterbury setting and friendly atmosphere make it a relaxed spot for a round among the farming and academic community.

name: Kaiapoi Golf Club
description: A riverside parkland course in Kaiapoi, set along the banks of the Kaiapoi River just north of Christchurch. The water features and mature trees create an attractive and enjoyable golfing environment.

name: Methven Golf Club
description: A rural course near the ski village of Methven, offering spectacular views of the Southern Alps including Mt Hutt. The mountain scenery and crisp Canterbury air enhance every round at this welcoming country club.

name: Twizel Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland course near Lake Pukaki and Aoraki/Mount Cook in the Mackenzie Country. The turquoise glacial lake and towering peaks create one of the most dramatic backdrops in New Zealand golf.

name: Geraldine Golf Club
description: A pleasant rural parkland course in the charming garden village of Geraldine in South Canterbury. The well-kept layout and friendly atmosphere make it a lovely stop for golfers exploring the region between Christchurch and the Mackenzie Country.

name: Tekapo Golf Club
description: A stunning 9-hole beside the turquoise waters of Lake Tekapo, framed by the Southern Alps. The extraordinary natural setting, with its unique glacial lake colour and mountain panorama, makes this one of the most visually spectacular courses in the country.

name: Amberley Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole in scenic North Canterbury near Amberley, offering a peaceful country golfing experience. The rolling terrain and views of the surrounding hills provide an attractive setting for a relaxed round.

name: Rakaia Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole near the famous Rakaia River, renowned for its salmon fishing. The flat Canterbury Plains setting and quiet country atmosphere make it a pleasant and unpretentious golfing experience.

name: Pleasant Point Golf Club
description: A charming rural 9-hole in the friendly South Canterbury village of Pleasant Point. The relaxed, unpretentious atmosphere and tidy layout make it an enjoyable round for golfers exploring the countryside between Timaru and the Mackenzie Basin.

name: Fairlie Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole at the gateway to the Mackenzie Basin, with views of the surrounding high-country hills. The small-town charm and spectacular scenery make it a delightful stop for golfers heading into the Mackenzie Country.
